subject.title: Memory MVP: add review, edit, forget, and conflict-resolution flows

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for the durable memory lifecycle contract, or should another open memory item become the canonical owner for review/edit/forget/conflict flows?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested flows, and the remaining work spans data model, privacy/retention, operator UX, Memory Audit, and write-pipeline behavior that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep as lifecycle umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open as the product/design owner until a maintainer-sponsored lifecycle design or merged PR covers review, edit, tombstone/forget, supersede, and conflict resolution.

options.title: Narrow to Memory Audit
options.body: Use the Memory Audit PR as the first implementation path, but keep this issue open until that PR is mergeable and covers or splits all lifecycle requirements.

options.title: Defer behind schema/write pipeline
options.body: Explicitly block this issue on the schema and write-pipeline MVP issues before accepting review/edit/forget UI or CLI work.

recommendation.title: Keep as lifecycle umbrella
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the product/design owner until a maintainer-sponsored lifecycle design or merged PR covers review, edit, tombstone/forget, supersede, and conflict resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc appears in adjacent memory event history and issue mentions, making him the best routing owner for the product-direction choice among the likely owners.
